goal: Add three foundation capabilities to f(x): 1) auto-generated project structure file with fingerprint-based updates, 2) dangerous-code security filter before writing files, 3) logging of agent reasoning/thoughts (not only actions).

context.working_copy: A clean duplicate of f(x) is the active project. Unrelated logs and extra tools were removed so agents focus only on this task.
already_available: Updated Reviewer prompt (must rely on real run logs)
lesson_manager exists but is not the main focus of this task
Git autocommit and console commands exist
problems_found_in_real_test: Agents poorly understand folder hierarchy and relative paths
Reviewer can rubber-stamp code without real verification
Agent reasoning is not visible enough
Generated code previously attempted dangerous file deletion via os/shutil

behavior: Scan the selected project root recursively
Ignore common junk: .git, __pycache__, .vs, bin, obj, node_modules, iteration_logs, AI_Orchestrator_Backups, .env
Build a readable tree in PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md
Save fingerprint + updated_at + file_count in structure_meta.json
If fingerprint unchanged, do not rewrite files unnecessarily
Detect dangerous code patterns before file write
Block patterns related to destructive file operations and shell deletion
Return list of hits; empty list means safe
Must detect at least: os.remove, os.unlink, shutil.rmtree, Path.unlink, os.system, rm -rf, Remove-Item -Recurse
2_security_filter.integration: Orchestrator must call security filter BEFORE safe_write_code. If hits found: do not write file; put explanation into compiler_output / security_output; send to review step.

behavior: Store not only actions/timestamps, but agent reasoning summaries
After each agent step append a short thought record
Include fields when available: analysis/plan (Researcher), why (Editor), verdict/root_cause/fix_instruction/reasoning_summary (Reviewer)

required_flow: Pass structure text into Researcher/Editor context
After Editor returns code: run security_filter
If safe: write file, then run build/test runner, then Reviewer
If unsafe: skip write, mark as failed security check, go to Reviewer with log

constraints: Do not implement Activation Score, sleep mode, Manager role, or semantic memory
Do not refactor the whole system
All new tools must be pure Python and self-hosted
Prefer small functions and explicit file operations
Do not use destructive file operations in generated tooling itself

plan.title: Implement tools/project_structure.py
details: Create scanner + fingerprint + markdown tree writer
Write PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md and structure_meta.json into target project root

plan.title: Implement tools/security_filter.py
details: Regex/pattern based detection of dangerous code

plan.title: Add reasoning log output
details: Create or extend logger to write status/last_thoughts.md
Record researcher/editor/reviewer reasoning fields when present

plan.title: Review and fix via real runner logs
details: No approve if logs show failure
Create observation if a real root cause is found

definition_of_done: tools/project_structure.py exists and can generate PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md + structure_meta.json
Structure file updates when files/folders change and stays unchanged when fingerprint is the same
tools/security_filter.py blocks dangerous destructive file operations before writing
Orchestrator refuses to write unsafe code and reports the block in logs/state
Agent reasoning summaries are written to status/last_thoughts.md or equivalent
main.py integration works in order: structure -> edit -> security -> write -> test/build -> review
A short smoke run completes without crash
notes_for_agents: Researcher: produce a short technical plan with exact files to create/modify and function names. Use paths relative to project root.
Editor: implement one concrete piece at a time. Keep code simple. Do not invent extra features outside requirements.
Reviewer: approve only if real run/security logs support success. If structure/security integration is incomplete, return fix_instruction.
